integrity: Self-contained analytic proof of the continuum statement; standard-library rational stress checks replayed. The relevant graph-space and convex-polytope literature was examined; equivalent unindexed ellipsoid-section work cannot be excluded. No external independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result is for real three-dimensional Lipschitz-free spaces of four-cycle metrics with three edge lengths 1 and one length \(0<t\leq3\). It does not give a complex analogue, a classification of all four-point metrics, or uniqueness of non-symmetric best ellipsoids. The finite rational verifier is corroborative, not a continuum proof.
title: Exact Euclidean distortion of a one-defect four-cycle transportation space
